scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,audit -c cyan,green,yellow "npm --prefix apps/web run dev" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:audit"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/web run build && dotnet build apps/services/Syncora.Audit/Syncora.Audit.csproj --configuration Release
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/web run lint && python -m ruff check apps/api
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/web test -- --run && python -m pytest apps/api/tests && dotnet test apps/services/Syncora.Audit.Tests/Syncora.Audit.Tests.csproj
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/web install && python -m pip install -r apps/api/requirements.txt && dotnet restore apps/services/Syncora.Audit/Syncora.Audit.csproj
